description: This file contains a public enum 'CameraCapturePipelineSupport' which provides static methods for preparing and managing camera sessions, including photo and movie capture sessions, warming up sessions, error handling, and utility functions related to camera configurations using AVFoundation framework.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for taking photos with specified camera preferences, returning the session, device, and output.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for movie recording with specified configurations, returning the session and output.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Asynchronously prepares and starts a movie session for warm-up purposes, returning the session and output.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Performs an operation with a warmed-up movie session, ensuring the session is stopped afterward, using async/await pattern.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps CameraSessionConfigurationError to a custom error, distinguishing microphone issues and other failures.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates and configures AVCapturePhotoSettings based on available codec types.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously using a delegate provided by a closure.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Perfoms a short delay to reduce initial blank frames when starting camera sessions.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for AVCaptureDevice.Position.
